evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence item (e.g. EV-LOG-001, EV-MET-002, EV-CODE-003).

timestamp.description: Timestamp or time window associated with this evidence.

description.description: Concise summary of what this piece of evidence demonstrates.

raw_snippet.description: Raw log line, metric point, code diff, or configuration extract.

metadata.description: Additional structured context such as service name, metric key, or file path.
